$comment: Kill switches: every on/off switch in the bridge, relay and Mac app. scripts/flags.test.ts checks this file against the code.
A new switch: values 0|1, unset = off = today's behaviour, read in one place (bridge: flag() in apps/bridge/src/config.ts;
relay: flag01 in apps/relay/src/env.ts; Mac: one ProcessInfo environment read compared to "1"), and a test of its off path with
flag:<NAME> in its title. Bridge names are TALOS_APP_<NAME>. Give removeBy a date when the switch is temporary.
legacy: switches older than this file, kept as they are (their real default, their own precedence); the text says why.

flags.name: TALOS_APP_BRIDGE
flags.legacy: older than flags.json. hook-cli reads the hook's own environment only, never bridge.env: a scheduled claude -p job must never be taken for the live bridge

flags.name: TALOS_APP_APPS
flags.legacy: older than flags.json. switch.ts puts bridge.env before the process environment (the reverse of loadEnv), so writing off in the file turns apps off in a running bridge started with TALOS_APP_APPS=1

flags.name: TALOS_APP_SCHEDULER
flags.legacy: older than flags.json; three values (auto, chronos, off), not 0|1

flags.name: TALOS_APP_CHRONOS_AUTODISCOVER
flags.legacy: older than flags.json; on unless off. Test runs turn it off (apps/bridge/test/preload.ts) so a test bridge never finds the owner's real Chronos

flags.name: TALOS_MEMORY_REFLEX_OFF
flags.legacy: the kit hook's own switch (kit/hooks/memory-reflex.py), older than this file: 1 turns off the note pointers in read_inbound as it turns off the hook, so one switch stops both; dev.note_lookup is the app's

flags.name: TALOS_APP_MEMORY_WATCH
flags.legacy: older than flags.json; on unless 0, read from the process environment

flags.name: TALOS_EXPLAINER
flags.legacy: older than flags.json; on when a claude is on PATH, off for off, 0, false or no

flags.name: DEVICE_PROOF_REQUIRED
flags.legacy: older than flags.json; a raw '0'|'1' string, not flag01

flags.name: WORK_INTEGRATIONS
flags.legacy: older than flags.json; allow|off, where off is the hard kill for every work integration

flags.name: SHARE_ENABLED
flags.legacy: older than flags.json; on unless 0 (0 = every /api/share* route answers 404)

flags.name: TALOS_SELFTEST_FORCE_FAIL
flags.legacy: older than flags.json; makes the self-test fail on purpose, for testing it
